subject: Pilot rev-share + lead registration process
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sarah Lane <sarah.lane@apex-consulting.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot rev-share + lead registration process

Hi Sarah — great speaking earlier. As discussed, attaching a starter term sheet and a simple lead-registration CSV we use to track credits. High-level proposal below: 

- 12-month pilot (Jan–Dec 2027)
- Tiered referral credit: 10% for first $0–50k ARR, 7% for $50k–200k, 5% thereafter
- Lead validation window: 30 days from lead submission for warm intro / conversion qualification
- Payout rhythm: monthly payouts net-30 after payment is received from customer

Please review the revshare-term-sheet-v1.pdf and the lead-registration-template.csv attached. Two asks for next week: (1) confirm your preferred validation workflow (email + discovery call vs SDR handoff), and (2) confirm whether Apex needs invoice-level remittance reporting.

Thanks — I looped in Laura from Partner Ops for intake/ops questions.

Best,
Karthik
Head of Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: revshare-term-sheet-v1.pdf (PDF, 28KB), lead-registration-template.csv (CSV, 2KB)

From: Sarah Lane <sarah.lane@apex-consulting.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: partner_ops@apex-consulting.com
Date: 2026-11-01T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot rev-share + lead registration process

Thanks Karthik — appreciate the clear outline. A few quick clarifications from our side:

1) Lead validation: our ops team prefers an email + short form (we can accept the CSV) but want a playbook for when Redwood SDRs follow up. Can we add a "handoff confirmed" flag on the registration template?
2) Payments: Apex prefers quarterly consolidated invoices for payouts; does Redwood have a finance contact who can accept quarterly invoices and consolidated remittance reports?
3) Exclusivity: we noted the term sheet is silent on vertical exclusivity — can you confirm if this pilot is non-exclusive?

I'll review the PDF in detail and send redlines by Thursday. Also copying our ops alias so they see the template.

—Sarah
VP, Partnerships
Apex Consulting

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Sarah Lane <sarah.lane@apex-consulting.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T10:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot rev-share + lead registration process

Looping in finance context here. A few notes on payout mechanics and what we need from Apex to do quarterly consolidated payments (if we agree to that):

- Redwood can do quarterly consolidated payouts, but accounting will need: invoice reference (HubSpot deal id or Customer PO), customer payment date, and an itemized commission ledger per invoice.
- Proposed payout cadence if quarterly: Redwood issues a consolidated payment within 45 days after quarter close (to align internal AR cycles).
- We'll need Apex to accept a remittance CSV in our standard format — draft attached (payout-schedule-draft.xlsx).

Operational asks for partner ops: please confirm which party owns the "handoff confirmed" flag and whether Apex will create a short-form link we can use to mark lead conversion during SDR handoffs.

Ben Carter
Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: payout-schedule-draft.xlsx (XLSX, 14KB)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sarah Lane <sarah.lane@apex-consulting.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot rev-share + lead registration process

Hi Sarah — quick ops response: we can add a "handoff_confirmed" column to the CSV template and also accept a one-click form URL that marks the lead as validated. Proposed intake flow (short):

1) Apex submits lead via CSV or web form (required fields: lead_email, company, region, estimated ARR, originating_apex_rep)
2) Redwood SDR attempts initial outreach within 3 business days; if handoff needed, SDR updates our form and triggers the flag (handoff_confirmed = true)
3) Apex ops will attach any discovery notes in the HubSpot comment field and cc partner_ops@apex-consulting.com on the initial outreach for validation within 30 days

I'll update the lead-registration-template.csv to include the handoff_confirmed flag and a small notes field. If that works for you, Karthik and Ben, I'll share the updated template and a short checklist for pilot onboarding.

—Laura
Partner Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Lane <sarah.lane@apex-consulting.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T15:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot rev-share + lead registration process

Thanks everyone — this sounds workable. A few final points before we sign: 

- Non-exclusive pilot confirmed on our side.
- Apex will accept the "handoff_confirmed" flag and we will provide a one-click form URL for marking lead validation.
- We prefer quarterly consolidated payouts; Sarah (finance) will accept Redwood's consolidated payment terms. Please send a sample remittance report and the DocuSign link and we'll return signed redlines by EOD next Wednesday.

I'll have our legal ops prepare a short-list of redlines; if Redwood can prepare the DocuSign in parallel that would speed things up.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — excited to get started.

Best,
Sarah Lane
VP, Partnerships
Apex Consulting
